description.text: Maincourses:Chinese Comprehensive Course, listening Chinese, Chinese character, spoken language, Technical Chinese, reading and writing, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, HSK dictation and English (optional). Text book:《chinese dialog301》《elementary chinese textbook》1-2 《cheinese language elementary hearing 》1 《chinese dialog301》 《elementary chinese textbook》3 《cheinese language elementary hearing 》2 and etc.

duration.text: The Propaedeutic Education of Chinese at Tianjin University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per semester ￥ 12000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.High school academic transcript 4.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: 1. An equivalent of China's high-school graduation education; 2. Final education certificate and transcript; 3. Over 18-years in age; 4. A minimum requirement of HSK 3 or learnt Chinese over one year;
